title: Inventory API — TypeError
tagline: GET /products/{sku}/gross-price returns 500: a CSV-imported price is a string.
expected_error: TypeError: can't multiply sequence by non-int of type 'float'
seeded_defect: PRODUCTS stores price as a string, and gross_price multiplies it by a float tax multiplier.
expected_fix: Coerce the price to float at the point of use.
